question: Which statement best captures the modern definition of Test Engineering?
options: A proactive engineering discipline integrating quality practices across the SDLC to prevent defects.
A reactive inspection activity conducted solely after development completes to catch errors across enterprise application environments.
A maintenance procedure restricted exclusively to automated GUI regression script execution.
An administrative process focused on calculating deployment budgets and tracking billable hours.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Slaytlardaki modern tanıma göre Test Mühendisliği; yazılım geliştirme yaşam döngüsünün (SDLC) tamamına kaliteyi entegre eden, hataları ortaya çıkmadan önlemeye odaklanan proaktif bir mühendislik disiplinidir. Yalnızca kod bittikten sonra hata arayan reaktif bir aktivite (A) veya yalnızca GUI otomasyonu (C) değildir.

question: What is the primary conceptual distinction between Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC)?
options: QA focuses on inspecting finished artifacts; QC defines policies and development guidelines.
QA is process-oriented ensuring quality methods; QC is product-oriented verifying deliverables.
QA is product-oriented to find flaws; QC is process-oriented to optimize organizational flow across enterprise application environments.
QA is executed only by end users; QC is executed exclusively by automated test engines.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Quality Assurance (QA) süreç odaklıdır (process-oriented); kalite standartları, denetimler ve süreç iyileştirmeleriyle kalitenin sağlanacağına dair güven oluşturur. Quality Control (QC) ise ürün odaklıdır (product-oriented); ortaya çıkan teslimatın gereksinimleri karşılayıp karşılamadığını test ve incelemelerle denetler.

question: Which pair of fundamental questions correctly differentiates Verification from Validation?
options: Verification: 'Are we building the right product?' — Validation: 'Are we building the product right?'
Verification: 'Does the code compile without warnings?' — Validation: 'Does the test suite finish quickly?'
Verification: 'Are we building the product right?' — Validation: 'Are we building the right product?'
Verification: 'Will this scale under peak server load?' — Validation: 'Is the underlying database normalized?'
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Klasik yazılım mühendisliği ve slayt tanımına göre: Verification (Doğrulama) 'Ürünü doğru mu inşa ediyoruz?' (spesifikasyonlara ve standartlara uygunluk), Validation (Geçerleme) ise 'Doğru ürünü mü inşa ediyoruz?' (kullanıcı ve paydaşların gerçek ihtiyaçlarına uygunluk) sorusuna yanıt arar.

question: According to foundational testing principles, what does software testing provide to stakeholders?
options: An absolute statistical warranty that zero residual faults remain in the executable codebase.
Complete legal immunity against third-party data breaches and infrastructure service outages.
A definitive mathematical proof that software components will operate perpetually without error.
Objective information regarding product quality and operational risk, not absolute guarantees.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Test prensiplerine göre yazılım testi mutlak bir hatasızlık garantisi veremez (Dijkstra: 'Testing can show the presence of errors, but never their absence'). Test, sistemin kalitesi ve barındırdığı riskler hakkında nesnel bilgi sağlar.

question: Which of the following activities represents Dynamic Testing rather than Static Testing?
options: Sending real HTTP payloads to REST API endpoints and inspecting the generated responses.
Scanning application production application source code repositories using automated static analysis and linter linters.
Reviewing architecture design documents and checking third-party dependency licenses.
Inspecting system requirements specifications during an interactive team walkthrough.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Dinamik test (Dynamic Testing), kodun fiilen çalıştırılmasını (execution) gerektirir. API uç noktalarına HTTP istekleri gönderip yanıtları doğrulamak dinamik testtir. Gereksinim incelemeleri (A), SAST/linter taramaları (B) ve mimari doküman gözden geçirmeleri (C) kodu çalıştırmadan yapılan Statik Test (Static Testing) örnekleridir.

question: What is the primary rationale behind adopting a 'Shift-Left' approach in software quality engineering?
options: To migrate all manual testing duties exclusively to operations teams during product rollout.
To introduce testing and review activities into early phases when defect remediation is cheapest.
To postpone intensive test design until the complete implementation passes beta acceptance.
To eliminate the necessity for unit tests by executing continuous monitoring in live environments.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Shift-Left yaklaşımı, test ve kalite faaliyetlerini yazılım yaşam döngüsünün soluna (en erken evrelerine; gereksinim, analiz, mimari tasarım) taşır. Hatalar ne kadar erken tespit edilirse, düzeltme maliyeti o kadar düşük olur.

question: In the ISO/IEC 25010 software product quality model, how many primary characteristics are defined?
options: 4 characteristics governing functionality, architecture, operational staffing, and licensing.
6 characteristics focusing solely on runtime computation, database persistence, and hardware.
8 characteristics providing a comprehensive trade-off framework for evaluating product quality.
12 characteristics categorizing development methodologies, static software build compiler and syntax analyzer flags, and CI pipelines.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. ISO/IEC 25010 ürün kalite modeli tam 8 ana karakteristik tanımlar: Functional Suitability, Performance Efficiency, Compatibility, Usability, Reliability, Security, Maintainability ve Portability.

question: Which set of sub-characteristics belongs to 'Functional Suitability' in the ISO/IEC 25010 standard?
options: Time behavior, operational resource utilization, and throughput transaction capacity.
Modularity, component reusability, source analyzability, and code testability.
Confidentiality, non-repudiation, user accountability, and system authenticity.
Functional completeness, functional correctness, and functional appropriateness.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. ISO/IEC 25010 standardında Functional Suitability (İşlevsel Uygunluk) 3 alt karakteristiğe ayrılır: Functional completeness (tamlık), Functional correctness (doğruluk) ve Functional appropriateness (uygunluk).

question: Which primary ISO/IEC 25010 characteristic evaluates time behavior, resource utilization, and capacity?
options: Performance Efficiency, by measuring execution responsiveness and computing resource consumption.
Reliability, by assessing operational fault tolerance and system recovery mechanisms across enterprise application environments.
Maintainability, by quantifying modularity and the effort needed to refactor algorithms.
Compatibility, by determining how seamlessly software coexists with other host applications.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Zaman davranışı (time behavior/response time), kaynak kullanımı (resource utilization/CPU, RAM) ve kapasite (capacity) metrikleri 'Performance Efficiency' (Performans Verimliliği) karakteristiğinin alt başlıklarıdır.

question: Fault tolerance, maturity, availability, and recoverability are sub-characteristics of which quality attribute?
options: Usability, which governs how easily users can learn, navigate, and operate the user interface.
Reliability, which reflects a system's capability to maintain a specified level of performance.
Portability, which measures the ease with which an application adapts to different target platforms.
Security, which ensures that authorized transactions are logged with strict non-repudiation.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Reliability (Güvenilirlik); maturity (olgunluk), availability (kullanılabilirlik/erişilebilirlik), fault tolerance (hata toleransı) ve recoverability (kurtarılabilirlik) alt karakteristiklerini içerir.

question: Which ISO/IEC 25010 quality characteristic incorporates modularity, analyzability, modifiability, and testability?
options: Portability, reflecting how easily software can be transferred between operating systems.
Compatibility, reflecting how independently software coexists within shared network hardware.
Maintainability, reflecting the effectiveness and efficiency with which code can be modified.
Functional Suitability, reflecting whether the specified features meet the business domain goals.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Maintainability (Bakım Yapılabilirlik); modularity (modülerlik), reusability (yeniden kullanılabilirlik), analyzability (analiz edilebilirlik), modifiability (değiştirilebilirlik) ve testability (test edilebilirlik) unsurlarını kapsar.

question: Which sub-characteristic is specifically categorized under 'Usability' in the ISO/IEC 25010 model?
options: Non-repudiation, ensuring that actions or events cannot be successfully denied later.
Interoperability, enabling multiple distinct software modules to exchange data reliably.
Installability, ensuring that software setup packages complete successfully on target systems.
User error protection, assisting users in avoiding and recovering from operational mistakes.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Usability (Kullanılabilirlik) alt karakteristikleri: appropriateness recognizability, learnability, operability, user error protection (kullanıcı hatası koruması), user interface aesthetics ve accessibility'dir.

question: Which group of attributes directly belongs to the 'Security' characteristic of ISO/IEC 25010?
options: Confidentiality, data integrity, non-repudiation, accountability, and user authenticity.
Modularity, architectural reusability, algorithm analyzability, and automated testability.
Time behavior, network bandwidth utilization, database concurrency, and CPU memory capacity.
Environment adaptability, setup installability, dependency replaceability, and coexistence.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Security (Güvenlik) karakteristiği; gizlilik (confidentiality), bütünlük (integrity), inkar edilemezlik (non-repudiation), hesap verebilirlik (accountability) ve kimlik doğrulama/özgünlük (authenticity) bileşenlerinden oluşur.

question: What is the core principle governing Equivalence Partitioning (EP) as a black-box test design technique?
options: Executing every internal branch and decision condition using all possible variable permutations.
Partitioning input domains into classes where members are assumed to be processed equivalently.
Testing exclusively the outermost edges and numerical boundary transitions of every data type.
Generating thousands of pseudo-random input strings to discover unexpected memory leaks.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Equivalence Partitioning (Eşdeğerlik Bölümleme); girdi alanını sistemin aynı şekilde işleyeceği varsayılan sınıflara (partitions/classes) ayırır. Her sınıftan seçilen tek bir temsilci değer test edilerek tüm sınıf doğrulanmış kabul edilir.

question: Why is Boundary Value Analysis (BVA) considered an essential complement to Equivalence Partitioning?
options: Because testing boundaries guarantees 100% statement and condition coverage in unit test suites.
Because boundary values evaluate internal private state variables without needing public API calls.
Because defects have a documented historical tendency to cluster at the boundaries of input ranges.
Because boundary analysis eliminates the requirement for writing automated test assertion checks.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. BVA, hataların özellikle aralık sınırlarında (off-by-one errors, < yerine <= kullanımı vb.) kümelendiği gerçeğine dayanır. Bu yüzden sınırın hemen altı, sınır noktası ve hemen üstü test edilir.

question: A system accepts passwords with length 8 to 20 characters. Which set represents the valid and invalid EP classes?
options: Invalid: length = 7; Valid: length = 8; Invalid: length = 21.
Invalid: length = 0; Valid: length = 14; Invalid: length = 100.
Valid: length < 8; Invalid: length 8 to 20; Valid: length > 20.
Invalid: length < 8; Valid: length 8 to 20; Invalid: length > 20.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Eşdeğerlik bölümlemesinde aralıklar sınıf olarak ele alınır: 8'den küçükler (Invalid), 8 ile 20 arası (Valid) ve 20'den büyükler (Invalid). A şıkkı ise EP değil BVA (sınır değer) örnekleridir.

question: For the same password rule (valid length 8 to 20 characters), which integer lengths represent comprehensive BVA testing?
options: Lengths: 7, 8, 9, 20, and 21 characters.
Lengths: 1, 4, 10, 15, and 50 characters.
Lengths: 8, 12, 16, 20, and 24 characters.
Lengths: 0, 8, 14, 20, and 99 characters.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Slayttaki worked example'a göre 8-20 aralığının sınır değerleri min-1, min, min+1 ve max, max+1 değerleridir. Dolayısıyla test edilmesi gereken uzunluklar 7, 8, 9, 20 ve 21'dir.

question: When is Decision Table testing particularly advantageous over simple Equivalence Partitioning?
options: When individual inputs are completely independent and require no conditional validation logic.
When testing complex business rules that depend on combinations of multiple input conditions.
When verifying continuous mathematical functions that have infinite floating-point domains.
When the primary testing goal is to measure hardware power consumption during background tasks.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Karar Tabloları (Decision Tables); sistem çıktısının birden çok koşulun farklı kombinasyonlarına bağlı olduğu karmaşık iş mantığını ve kurallarını test etmek için en uygun tekniktir.

question: In Risk-Based Testing (RBT) using an FMEA-style model, how is the Risk Priority Number (RPN) calculated?
options: Risk Priority Number = Execution Time (seconds) x Code Coverage (%) / Defect Count.
Risk Priority Number = Developer Experience x Story Points x Sprint Duration in days.
Risk Priority Number = Likelihood x Impact x Detectability (each evaluated on a rating scale).
Risk Priority Number = Total Lines of Code / Cyclomatic Complexity x Mutation Score across enterprise application environments.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Slaytlardaki RBT formülüne göre Risk (RPN) = Likelihood (Olasılık) × Impact (Etki) × Detectability (Fark Edilebilirlik) formülüyle (genellikle 1-5 puan arası) hesaplanır.

question: What testing strategy is recommended for software components exhibiting high Risk Priority Numbers (RPN)?
options: Deferring their verification to end-user beta testing while prioritizing lower-risk modules.
Removing assertion statements to ensure that automated build pipelines finish without failing.
Skipping unit testing entirely and relying solely on high-level UI automated recordings.
Subjecting them to deeper testing, including negative scenarios, fuzzing, stress, and security probes.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Slayta göre yüksek RPN puanına sahip (yüksek riskli) bileşenler; ek senaryolar, negatif testler, fuzzing, stres/performans ve güvenlik testleri gibi çok daha derinlemesine test faaliyetlerine tabi tutulmalıdır.

question: In a traditional Waterfall (sequential) lifecycle, what is the defined role of test engineering?
options: Operating testing as a distinct downstream phase occurring only after implementation finishes.
Guiding continuous daily peer code reviews throughout requirements and initial architecture.
Pairing continuously with developers to write unit tests before any functional code is produced.
Managing customer feedback loops and orchestrating automated deployments every sprint.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Şelale (Waterfall / Sequential) modelinde test faaliyeti, kodlama (implementation) tamamen tamamlandıktan sonra başlayan ayrık ve gecikmeli bir alt aşamadır (distinct downstream phase).

question: Why does regression testing become increasingly crucial in Incremental Software Development?
options: Because incremental delivery prohibits the use of automated unit testing frameworks in sprints.
Because each new increment may introduce unintended side effects into previously working features.
Because developers are not permitted to inspect software requirements until final deployment across enterprise application environments.
Because compiler optimizations frequently erase existing executable binaries between builds.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Artırımlı (Incremental) geliştirmede her yeni artırımda sisteme yeni kodlar eklenir. Bu eklemelerin önceden çalışan özellikleri bozup bozmadığını denetlemek için regresyon testleri (regression testing) kritik önem kazanır.

question: How do test engineering responsibilities transform within modern Agile and DevOps environments?
options: Test engineers become isolated into a detached department that only tests annual major releases.
Test engineers abandon test case design and focus exclusively on project management accounting.
Test engineers integrate into cross-functional teams, driving continuous testing and automation.
Test engineers execute manual verification procedures without participating in CI/CD pipelines.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Agile ve DevOps ortamlarında test mühendisleri çapraz fonksiyonlu (cross-functional) takımlara entegre olur; sürekli entegrasyon/teslimat (CI/CD), sürekli test (continuous testing), otomasyon ve Shift-Left süreçlerini birlikte yürütürler.

question: Which capability highlights the emerging role of AI in modern software quality engineering?
options: Eliminating the need for human stakeholders to define business goals or acceptance criteria.
Replacing all hardware virtualization platforms with physical mainframe test appliances.
Guaranteeing that all neural network generated algorithms are mathematically proven bug-free.
Assisting in automated test case generation, test execution analysis, and intelligent code review.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Slayttaki 'AI-Augmented Software Development' başlığına göre yapay zeka; gereksinim mühendisliği, test senaryosu üretimi (AI-generated test cases), test çalıştırma/hata analizi ve kod inceleme süreçlerinde asistandır.

question: According to the classic Test Pyramid described in course materials, what is the recommended test distribution?
options: Base: 70% Unit tests — Middle: 20% Integration tests — Top: 10% End-to-End GUI tests.
Base: 10% Unit tests — Middle: 20% Integration tests — Top: 70% End-to-End GUI tests across enterprise application environments.
Base: 33% Unit tests — Middle: 33% Integration tests — Top: 34% End-to-End GUI tests.
Base: 50% End-to-End tests — Middle: 30% Unit tests — Top: 20% Integration tests.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Test Piramidinde testlerin büyük çoğunluğunu tabandaki hızlı ve ucuz Unit Testler (%70), orta katmanı Integration Testleri (%20) ve tepedeki pahalı/yavaş GUI/E2E testleri (%10) oluşturmalıdır.

question: Which characteristic is fundamentally true of Unit Testing as defined in testing level hierarchies?
options: It is performed by independent QA testers on production hardware with live external databases.
It tests individual components in isolation, executing rapidly with mocked or stubbed dependencies.
It focuses primarily on verifying end-to-end user navigation flows across multiple microservices across enterprise application environments.
It requires all distributed network subsystems to be deployed before test execution can commence.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Unit testler en küçük test edilebilir parçaları (fonksiyon, sınıf) izole olarak doğrular; bağımlılıkları mock'lanır, son derece hızlı çalışır ve genellikle geliştiriciler tarafından yazılır.

question: What constitutes the primary scope and focus of Integration Testing?
options: Validating the visual layout and CSS color typography of individual web pages in web browsers.
Measuring customer satisfaction ratings and calculating product Net Promoter Scores (NPS).
Verifying data flow and communication interfaces between interacting software modules or services.
Compiling abstract syntax trees and verifying lexical tokens without executing application code across enterprise application environments.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Entegrasyon testinin (Integration Testing) temel amacı; birbiriyle etkileşim halinde olan bileşenlerin veya sistemlerin arayüzlerindeki veri akışını ve iletişim doğruluğunu sınamaktır.

question: What is the defining distinction between Top-Down and Bottom-Up incremental integration testing?
options: Top-Down uses test drivers; Bottom-Up relies strictly on test stubs for unwritten components.
Top-Down integrates all modules at once; Bottom-Up integrates components one by one randomly.
Top-Down is exclusively dynamic testing; Bottom-Up is strictly static document inspection.
Top-Down starts with high-level modules using stubs; Bottom-Up starts with low-level modules using drivers.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Top-down (Yukarıdan Aşağı) entegrasyonda en üst seviyedeki modüllerden başlanır ve henüz yazılmamış alt modüller için STUB kullanılır. Bottom-up (Aşağıdan Yukarı) entegrasyonda ise alt seviye modüllerden başlanır ve onları çağırmak için DRIVER kullanılır.

question: Which statement correctly describes the execution environment and responsibility for System Testing?
options: Executed on complete integrated software in a production-like environment by an independent test team.
Executed by original code authors inside their isolated local IDE development debuggers across enterprise application environments.
Executed by non-technical marketing specialists during initial requirement gathering workshops.
Executed exclusively inside continuous delivery pipelines before any code is checked into Git.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. System Testing; tüm bileşenleri entegre edilmiş komple sistemi, gerçeğe yakın (production-like) bir ortamda ve tarafsızlık amacıyla bağımsız bir test ekibi (independent test team) tarafından test eder.

question: How are Alpha Testing and Beta Testing distinguished within the Acceptance Testing level?
options: Alpha is performed by external users in real settings; Beta is conducted internally by organization staff.
Alpha is internal testing within the development organization; Beta is conducted by external real users.
Alpha tests software hardware drivers; Beta evaluates compiler warning flags and lint configurations.
Alpha is performed after final deployment; Beta is performed before any code is written or compiled.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Alpha Testi, kurum içinde (geliştirici organizasyon bünyesinde) kontrollü ortamda yapılan kabul testidir; Beta Testi ise gerçek kullanıcılar/müşteriler tarafından kendi gerçek kullanım ortamlarında gerçekleştirilir.

question: Which of the following represents a measurable, valid Acceptance Criterion as presented in course slides?
options: The code should look elegant and readable to every developer working across all project teams.
The application ought to be reasonably modern, user-friendly, and very robust against bugs.
The system must process 1,000 transactions per minute and allow 95% of users to check out in 3 minutes.
The build process should complete as fast as possible whenever anyone triggers a pull request across enterprise application environments.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Kabul kriterleri ölçülebilir, somut ve net olmalıdır. Slayttaki örneğe göre: 'System processes 1,000 transactions per minute; 95% of users complete checkout within 3 minutes; all regulatory compliance requirements met' ifadeleri net birer kabul kriteridir.

question: What is an essential ethical and professional responsibility of a test engineer regarding test data?
options: Exporting live unmasked customer credit card numbers to personal laptops to speed up offline debugging.
Modifying automated test run logs to report zero failures when management demands green build status.
Hiding known critical security vulnerabilities from stakeholders to avoid delaying scheduled releases.
Respecting privacy and PII by utilizing masked, anonymized, or synthetic datasets for test procedures.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Slaytlardaki 'Ethics & Professionalism' prensibine göre test mühendisleri: Gerçekleri dürüstçe raporlamalı, kişisel verilerin (PII) gizliliğine saygı duymalı ve test ortamlarında maskelenmiş veya sentetik veriler kullanmalıdır.

question: Which international standard specifically governs software testing processes and organizational models?
options: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119 standards for software testing processes, documentation, and techniques.
IEEE 754 standard for binary floating-point computation and hardware arithmetic rounding.
W3C HTML5 recommendation for document object model layout and responsive style cascading.
PCI-DSS standard for electronic point-of-sale terminal encryption and magnetic card reading.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Slayt referanslarında belirtildiği üzere yazılım testi süreçleri, teknikleri ve dokümantasyonunu kapsayan uluslararası temel standart 'ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119 Software Testing' standardıdır.

question: What is the primary defining characteristic of a Unit Test in modern software engineering?
options: It verifies the behavior of an isolated class, method, or function without external side effects.
It validates an entire distributed cloud microservice under simulated peak traffic loads across enterprise application environments.
It requires direct end-user interaction through web browser graphical user interface components.
It assesses long-term relational database indexing efficiency across millions of persistent rows.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Unit (Birim) testleri, bir yazılımın en küçük test edilebilir birimini (genellikle tek bir sınıf, metot veya fonksiyon) dış bağımlılıklardan izole ederek ve yan etkisiz biçimde doğrular.

question: According to the Test Pyramid model presented in the course slides, what are the recommended test ratios?
options: 10% Unit tests, 20% System tests, and 70% Graphical User Interface (GUI) tests.
70% Unit tests, 20% System tests, and 10% Graphical User Interface (GUI) tests.
33% Unit tests, 33% Integration tests, and 34% Stakeholder User Acceptance tests.
50% Unit tests, 0% System interaction tests, and 50% End-to-End browser workflow tests.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Slaytlardaki Test Piramidi (Testing Percentages) kuralına göre test havuzunun %70'ini Unit testler, %20'sini System/Integration testleri ve %10'unu GUI/E2E testleri oluşturmalıdır.

topic: Why Unit Tests Form the Base
question: Why are Unit Tests positioned as the foundational base (70%) of an effective testing strategy?
options: Because they completely eliminate the requirement for system configuration or security penetration checks.
Because they are designed by end-users to evaluate overall business marketability and user satisfaction.
Because they execute in milliseconds, cost very little to run, and isolate faults to exact code lines.
Because their creation can only be accomplished using specialized enterprise proprietary testing tools.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Birim testler milisaniyeler içinde çalışır, yürütme maliyetleri çok düşüktür, bir hata olduğunda hatanın hangi sınıf veya satırda olduğunu doğrudan gösterir (hata izolasyonu) ve hızlı geri bildirim sağlar.

question: Why does the standard testing pyramid recommend restricting GUI-level tests to approximately 10%?
options: Because graphical user interfaces are immune to logical defects and rarely need verification across enterprise application environments.
Because modern browser security protocols strictly prohibit automated script test interaction.
Because compiler engines automatically execute comprehensive visual rendering checks during every build.
Because GUI tests run slowly, break easily upon minor layout revisions, and carry high maintenance costs.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. GUI testleri (Test Piramidinin tepesindeki %10) çalışması en yavaş olan, en küçük arayüz/buton değişikliğinde kırılabilen (flaky/brittle) ve bakımı en masraflı test türüdür.

question: What is the essential distinction between White Box and Black Box testing methodologies?
options: White Box testing has full access to internal source structure; Black Box tests without internal knowledge.
White Box testing is executed exclusively by hand; Black Box testing is performed only by automated tools.
White Box testing evaluates network physical cables; Black Box testing analyzes software user interface texts.
White Box testing runs only on cloud platforms; Black Box testing runs strictly on isolated local computers.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Slayt tanımına göre: Black Box testinde sistemin iç yapısı ve kaynak kodu gizlidir; yalnızca girdi-çıktı davranışı test edilir. White Box testinde ise test mühendisi kaynak kodun ve iç yapının detaylarına tam olarak hakimdir.

question: Which fundamental criterion differentiates Static Testing from Dynamic Testing?
options: Whether the software application is implemented in a statically typed language such as Java or C#.
Whether the testing procedure physically compiles and executes the application code during evaluation.
Whether the testing session is conducted on local developer machines or inside continuous cloud servers.
Whether the test data inputs are defined using static numerical constants instead of dynamic random strings.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Slaytlardaki temel soru: 'Does it execute the code?' (Kodu çalıştırıyor mu?). Eğer kod çalıştırılıyorsa Dynamic, kod çalıştırılmadan inceleniyorsa (kod inceleme, linter, doküman gözden geçirme) Static testtir.

question: What do the three phases of the widely adopted AAA unit testing design pattern represent?
options: Allocate test memory buffers, Author the test documentation, and Archive runtime diagnostic logs.
Analyze requirement tickets, Automate continuous delivery scripts, and Approve deployment release candidates.
Arrange prerequisites and inputs, Act by executing the method under test, and Assert expected outcomes.
Authenticate API credentials, Audit server thread performance, and Abandon unhandled exception traces.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. AAA Kalıbı: Arrange (Test nesnelerini, durumları ve girdileri hazırla), Act (Test edilen metodu veya eylemi çalıştır) ve Assert (Sonucun beklenen şartı sağlayıp sağlamadığını doğrula).

question: What specific actions occur during the 'Arrange' phase of a structured unit test?
options: The test asserts whether the computed mathematical result strictly matches the expected target constant across enterprise application environments.
The test clears temporary directory cache files and releases network connection handles to avoid leaks.
The test triggers the target class method and captures the returned payload value for later inspection.
The test instantiates necessary objects, initializes input parameters, and configures test mock fixtures.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Arrange aşamasında test edilecek nesneler oluşturulur (instantiation), başlangıç durumları ayarlanır, girdiler belirlenir ve gerekirse mock/stub dublörleri hazır hale getirilir.

question: Which activity defines the 'Act' phase within the standard AAA unit testing structure?
options: Invoking the specific function or method under test to stimulate the behavior being evaluated.
Evaluating whether the outcome conforms to the assertions written in the test validation block.
Setting up test doubles and stubbing dependent external database communication calls in memory.
Writing diagnostic trace messages into disk log files to record execution progress for audits.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Act aşaması, test edilen sınıfın davranışını tetiklemek amacıyla ilgili metot veya fonksiyonun fiilen çağrıldığı (execute edildiği) bölümdür.

question: What is the primary role of the 'Assert' phase in an automated unit test suite?
options: Allocating thread memory pools to ensure the program finishes execution within prescribed limits.
Replacing human visual inspection by verifying that runtime results satisfy expected specifications.
Simulating external service failure codes by injecting synthetic network timeout faults into sockets.
Initializing class member variables and loading configuration settings before methods are called.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Slayttaki ifadeye göre: 'Assertions replace us humans in checking that the software does what it should.' Assertion'lar, yazılımın beklenen gereksinimleri karşılayıp karşılamadığını insanlar yerine otomatik denetleyen doğrulama ifadeleridir.

question: What common historical problem do frameworks like JUnit and NUnit address in software engineering?
options: Software compilers failed to detect syntactic typographical mistakes without external framework intervention.
Automated test scripts required manual compilation with specialized physical punch card readers.
Testing was detached from development, preventing developers from measuring progress or detecting side effects.
Development teams lacked internet connectivity to download open-source persistent backend database systems client drivers.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Slaytlardaki JUnit/NUnit açıklamasına göre bu araçlar; testin geliştirmeden kopuk olması, neyin çalışıp neyin bozulduğunun anlaşılamaması ve ilerlemenin ölçülememesi sorununu çözer; yan etkilerin (unintended side effects) hemen fark edilmesini sağlar.

question: What core philosophy regarding test timing is emphasized in the unit testing lecture materials?
options: Develop tests exclusively after software has been deployed to client production servers for two months.
Delegate test development entirely to end customers through crowd-sourced online bug bounty programs.
Wait until graphical user interface designers complete all stylesheet mockups before drafting unit tests.
Develop automated tests in parallel with application code or even before writing the functional code.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Slaytlardaki JUnit/NUnit felsefesi: 'Develop tests in parallel with application code or before!!' (Testleri uygulama koduyla paralel veya koddan bile önce yazın!).

question: In standard testing terminology, what is the precise definition of an 'Error'?
options: A human action, mistake, or misunderstanding that produces an incorrect software work product.
An observable deviation in system execution where the program outputs an invalid runtime result.
A physical hardware failure occurring when server processors exceed safe thermal operating thresholds.
A static compiler syntax error that halts automated continuous integration script builds.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Error (Hata / İnsan Hatası): İnsanın yaptığı bir hata, yanlış anlama veya eylemdir (örneğin gereksinimi yanlış anlama veya kodda yanlış operatör kullanma). Kodda ortaya çıkan kusura (Fault) sebep olur.

question: What is the technical definition of a 'Fault' (also known as a Defect or Bug) in software engineering?
options: A mistaken assumption made by an engineer during an informal requirements gathering session.
An imperfection or flaw in a software work product that can cause it to fail to perform its function.
An observable crash witnessed by an end-user when submitting an online e-commerce checkout cart across enterprise application environments.
A scheduled network maintenance window that temporarily interrupts cloud database connections.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Fault (Kusur / Defect / Bug): Yazılım ürününde veya kodunda yer alan, yazılımın beklenen işlevi yerine getirememesine yol açabilecek statik kusur ya da kusurlu durumdur.

question: How is a 'Failure' rigorously defined in software testing and reliability engineering?
options: An erroneous mental model formed by a programmer when reading an ambiguous specification document.
An uncommitted syntax flaw present on an engineer's personal local working directory branch.
An event where a system or component fails to perform a required function within specified limits.
A formal design review meeting where stakeholders request architectural modifications to an API.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Failure (Arıza / Başarısızlık): Sistemin veya bileşenin, çalışırken kendisinden beklenen işlevi belirtilen sınırlar içinde yerine getirememesi (runtime sapması) olayıdır.

question: Which sequence correctly illustrates the causal relationship connecting Error, Fault, and Failure?
options: A Failure during runtime leads a tester to create an Error, which writes a Fault to the database.
A hardware Failure forces developers to inject an Error, creating a Fault in the operating system kernel.
A static Fault in documentation causes a human Error, which terminates the build as a compiler Failure.
A human Error creates a Fault in the code, which when executed under certain conditions causes a Failure.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Nedensellik zinciri: İnsan hatası (Error) kodda veya tasarımda bir kusur (Fault/Defect) yaratır; bu kusurlu kod çalıştırıldığında (execution) sistem beklenen çıktıyı veremez ve arıza (Failure) meydana gelir.

topic: Can a Fault Exist Without Failure?
question: Can a software codebase contain an existing Fault without causing an observable Failure?
options: Yes, if the flawed code path is never executed, or if intermediate erroneous states are masked.
No, any fault in the source code immediately crashes the operating system upon application startup.
No, automated unit test suites are mathematically guaranteed to reveal all latent code flaws.
Yes, but only if the software is compiled exclusively on 32-bit hardware running legacy operating systems.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Bir kodda kusur (Fault) bulunabilir ancak o kod bloğu hiç çalıştırılmazsa (veya ortaya çıkan içsel hatalı durum diğer işlemlerle maskelenip dışarıya yansımazsa) gözlemlenebilir bir arıza (Failure) oluşmaz.

question: What is the typical behavior of an equality assertion (e.g., Assert.AreEqual(expected, actual)) when values differ?
options: It silently logs a warning to standard console output and continues running subsequent assertions.
It immediately throws an assertion exception, causing the current unit test method to fail.
It automatically mutates the actual variable value in memory to match the expected parameter constant.
It restarts the target operating system to determine whether hardware bit rot caused the difference.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Assert.AreEqual gibi eşitlik assertion'larında beklenen (expected) ile gerçekleşen (actual) değer uyuşmazsa bir assertion hatası (AssertionException) fırlatılır ve ilgili test derhal başarısız (fail) olur.

question: Why do many testing best practices favor maintaining a single conceptual assertion per unit test?
options: Because unit testing execution engines are incapable of compiling more than one assert call per file.
Because multiple assertions allow tests to run faster by bypassing intermediate validation checks.
Because if an early assertion fails, subsequent assertions are skipped, hiding remaining diagnostic clues.
Because having multiple assertions requires purchasing additional enterprise framework server seats.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Birim testlerde tek bir kavramsal doğrulama yapılması önerilir; çünkü bir test içinde birden çok assert olduğunda ilk assert fail verirse test o noktada kesilir ve sonraki assert'ler hiç çalıştırılamaz, bu da diğer hataları gizler.

question: When verifying the behavior of a single Java or C# class in isolation, which test level is being conducted?
options: Acceptance Testing, validating stakeholder usability and compliance with business workflows.
Performance Testing, determining peak concurrent connection limits on web server reverse proxies.
System Testing, verifying end-to-end integration across all distributed network databases.
Unit Testing, verifying the specific logic and internal contracts of that individual class.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Slayttaki 'Unit tests verify behavior of a single class' ifadesine göre tek bir sınıfın davranışını diğer sınıflardan bağımsız doğrulamak Unit Testing seviyesidir.

question: What do System Tests verify according to the test levels overview in the course slides?
options: They verify class interactions and holistic behavior across integrated components of the system.
They verify the isolated private algorithmic computations of a single standalone mathematical function.
They verify whether syntax indentation strictly conforms to team stylistic guidelines and linter rules.
They verify that the local developer environment has installed the latest operating system security patches.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Slayttaki kural: 'System tests verify class interactions' (Sistem testleri sınıfların birbiriyle etkileşimini ve sistemin bütünsel davranışını doğrular).

question: According to the course slides, what is the specific focus of GUI (Graphical User Interface) tests?
options: They calculate abstract algorithmic time complexity metrics for sorting and searching arrays.
They verify end-to-end user journeys and complete interactive workflows across the application.
They replace static software build compiler and syntax analyzer optimizers by verifying low-level binary register allocations in memory.
They inspect the source code formatting style without actually running the graphical program.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Slayttaki kural: 'GUI tests verify end-to-end journeys' (GUI testleri uçtan uca kullanıcı senaryolarını ve yolculuklarını doğrular).

question: What distinguishes Specification-based testing from Use-based testing in test categorization?
options: Specification testing inspects hardware specifications; Use testing evaluates disk driver controllers.
Specification testing is always manual; Use testing is conducted solely by automated crawler bots.
Specification testing tests against formal requirements; Use testing tests against actual user behaviors.
Specification testing runs only in production; Use testing is restricted strictly to local unit test files.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Slaytlardaki sınıflandırmaya göre: Spec-based testing (Şartnameye dayalı test) yazılımın yazılı gereksinim ve şartnamelere uygunluğunu test ederken, Use-based testing (Kullanıma dayalı test) gerçek kullanıcıların sistemi fiilen nasıl kullandığına ve profillerine odaklanır.

question: How does Functional Testing differ fundamentally from Random Testing?
options: Functional testing measures CPU power draw; Random testing assesses hard disk spindle velocity.
Functional testing requires no test assertions; Random testing demands formal mathematical proofs.
Functional testing can only be executed by end-users; Random testing is executed strictly by compilers.
Functional testing evaluates specific intended behaviors; Random testing feeds pseudo-random inputs.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Functional testing (İşlevsel test), belirli fonksiyonel gereksinim ve senaryolara dayalı olarak tasarlanır. Random testing (Rastgele test) ise sisteme rastgele girdiler (fuzzing/monkey testing) vererek beklenmeyen çökmeleri ve sınır aşımlarını yakalamayı hedefler.

question: Why is it critical that individual unit tests remain completely independent of one another?
options: Because unit testing runners must be able to execute tests in any arbitrary or parallel order reliably.
Because dependent tests automatically double the volatile central processing memory allocations usage required by server physical processors.
Because modern programming compilers refuse to generate bytecode if test methods share state variables.
Because independent tests guarantee that application relational database tables are never populated.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Birim testler birbirinden bağımsız (independent) olmalıdır; böylece herhangi bir sırada veya paralel olarak çalıştırıldıklarında paylaşılan durumdan (shared state) etkilenmezler ve birbirlerini yalancı arızalarla (flakiness) bozmazlar.

question: Why is rapid execution speed an indispensable property for a comprehensive unit test suite?
options: Because cloud hosting providers automatically delete source repositories whose test suites exceed 5 minutes.
Because slow test suites discourage developers from running tests frequently during local coding loops.
Because fast tests allow web browsers to render complex graphics with higher frame rate performance.
Because unit tests cannot achieve high line coverage unless they execute in fewer than 10 milliseconds.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Birim testlerin saniyeler içinde çalışması çok önemlidir; eğer test paketi yavaşlarsa geliştiriciler kod yazarken testi sık sık çalıştırmayı bırakırlar, bu da hataların birikmesine yol açar.

question: What is the purpose of testing for exceptions (e.g., Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>()) in unit tests?
options: To prevent the development compiler from issuing runtime warnings regarding unhandled error traces.
To automatically suppress runtime crashes so that server applications never terminate in production.
To verify that the code properly rejects invalid inputs or exceptional conditions by raising expected errors.
To replace standard logging libraries with built-in framework diagnostic exception handlers.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Exception assertion'ları (Assert.Throws vb.), sistemin geçersiz girdi veya sınır dışı durumlarda sessizce hatalı sonuç üretmek yerine beklenen özel durumu (exception) doğru şekilde fırlattığını doğrulamak için yazılır.

question: How do automated unit tests help development teams 'spot unintended side effects' during refactoring?
options: By automatically generating customer release documentation whenever an assertion passes successfully across enterprise application environments.
By notifying cloud security teams whenever developers commit code containing unapproved comments.
By monitoring CPU fan speeds to detect when complex algorithms consume excessive battery electricity.
By immediately failing when changes made to one method inadvertently break previously working functionality.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Slaytta belirtildiği gibi unit testler 'spot unintended side effects' sağlar; yani bir geliştirici kodda bir iyileştirme veya refactoring yaptığında, farkında olmadan bozduğu eski çalışan bir özellik varsa ilgili test hemen patlayarak geliştiriciyi uyarır.

question: What design characteristic makes a software class easily amenable to thorough unit testing?
options: Loosely coupling dependencies, favoring dependency injection, and isolating pure business computations.
Hardcoding persistent backend database systems connection strings and tightly coupling internal business logic to UI widgets.
Declaring all class members and methods as private static fields to prevent external access.
Writing entire software applications within a single massive monolithic class containing 10,000 lines.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Bir sınıfın test edilebilir (testable) olması için bağımlılıklarının gevşek bağlı (loosely coupled) olması, bağımlılık enjeksiyonuna (dependency injection) izin vermesi ve saf iş mantığının dış etkenlerden ayrılması gerekir.

question: What is the strategic value of building a test suite incrementally alongside daily software feature development?
options: It allows organizations to fire all dedicated quality assurance engineers before releasing product beta.
It builds a reliable regression safety net cheaply, providing ongoing visibility into project progress.
It guarantees that software will never experience cyber security vulnerabilities or malicious attacks.
It eliminates the need for software version control repositories like Git by preserving code in tests.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Slayttaki JUnit/NUnit gerekçesine göre: 'Using Unit Tests you can cheaply and incrementally build a test suite that will help you measure your progress, spot unintended side effects, and focus your development efforts.'

question: Which component in JUnit and NUnit is responsible for discovering and executing test methods automatically?
options: The Bytecode Disassembler, which converts Java classes into raw assembly code before each test run.
The Database Connection Pool, which maintains persistent network sockets for transactional tests.
The Test Runner, which scans annotations/attributes (e.g., @Test or [Test]) and manages execution flow.
The Operating System Kernel, which allocates physical CPU time slices directly to test classes.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Test Runner (Test Çalıştırıcı); test sınıflarındaki özel etiketleri (@Test, [Test] gibi) tarar, testleri sırayla veya paralel çalıştırır, assertion sonuçlarını toplayıp raporlar.

question: If a unit test requires reading files from an actual hard disk or calling a remote server, what has occurred?
options: The test has demonstrated that mocks and stubs are strictly obsolete in modern cloud environments.
The test has violated language syntax rules and will be rejected by the standard unit testing compiler.
The test has achieved perfect isolation and represents the ideal state of continuous delivery testing.
The test has expanded beyond the scope of a pure unit test and become an integration or system test.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Gerçek bir diske, veritabanına veya ağ üzerindeki bir servise bağlanan test artık saf bir Unit Test (Birim Test) değildir; dış sistemlerle iletişime geçtiği için bir Entegrasyon Testine (Integration Test) dönüşmüştür.

topic: Role of Assertions in Requirement Validation
question: How do assertions within unit tests relate to formal software specification requirements?
options: Assertions express concrete executable requirements that the unit under test is expected to satisfy.
Assertions exist solely to benchmark how many clock cycles the central processing unit consumes across enterprise application environments.
Assertions replace the need for writing functional code by generating business logic automatically.
Assertions are non-binding recommendations that compilers ignore during production release builds.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Slayt ifadesine göre: 'They express requirements that the unit under test is expected to meet.' Assertion'lar, test edilen birimin karşılaması beklenen gereksinimleri kodlanmış ve çalıştırılabilir şekilde ifade eder.

question: What is the foundational principle underlying Test-Driven Development (TDD)?
options: Authoring unit tests before writing functional code, driving software design through testing.
Writing exhaustive automated system tests after releasing software into staging environments across enterprise application environments.
Replacing all human code authors with machine learning automated test generation models.
Testing software exclusively through manual exploratory clicking across browser interfaces.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Test-Driven Development (TDD / Test Güdümlü Geliştirme); üretim (fonksiyonel) kodunu yazmadan önce başarısız bir birim test yazarak yazılım tasarımını testlerle yönlendirme prensibine dayanır.

question: Which sequence correctly represents the three recurring phases of the classic TDD cycle?
options: Refactor existing code, Green (run performance benchmarks), and Red (fix compiler syntax warnings).
Red (write a failing test), Green (write minimal code to pass), and Refactor (clean up code safely).
Green (write passing code), Red (delete failing assertions), and Refactor (reboot local server).
Red (deploy to production), Green (monitor server logs), and Refactor (revert database migrations).
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. TDD döngüsü üç adımdan oluşur: 1. Red (Önce başarısız olan bir test yaz), 2. Green (Testi geçirecek minimum kodu yaz), 3. Refactor (Testlerin yeşilliğini koruyarak kodu temizle ve optimize et).

question: What is the primary objective of the 'Red' phase in the Test-Driven Development methodology?
options: To prove that the current production release has encountered an unrecoverable database deadlock.
To highlight all syntax formatting errors using colorful editor themes before compiling binaries.
To write a concise unit test specifying a desired capability that fails before implementation begins.
To stop development immediately and escalate architectural ambiguities to corporate executives across enterprise application environments.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Red fazının amacı; henüz yazılmamış yeni bir özelliği veya davranışı belirten ve kod henüz yazılmadığı için doğal olarak başarısız (kırmızı) olan küçük bir test oluşturmaktır.

question: During the 'Green' phase of TDD, what rule guides the developer when implementing functional code?
options: Disable any previous tests that fail so the build status turns green as quickly as possible.
Over-engineer an enterprise-grade generic framework capable of supporting all anticipated future needs.
Refactor all related database schemas and rewrite historical API endpoint serialization logic.
Write the absolute minimum amount of code necessary to make the failing test pass successfully.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Green aşamasında temel kural: Testi geçirmek için gereken minimum ve en basit kodu yazmaktır (Keep It Simple). Erken optimizasyon veya aşırı mühendislikten (over-engineering) kaçınılır.

question: What is the purpose of the 'Refactor' phase, and what critical guarantee ensures its safety in TDD?
options: Improving code readability and structure while passing unit tests verify that behavior is preserved.
Adding substantial new business features while temporarily turning off automated assertion checks across enterprise application environments.
Converting all object-oriented classes into procedural shell scripts to improve execution velocity.
Deleting legacy unit tests to reduce disk usage and decrease the overall pipeline duration.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Refactor aşamasında kodun dış davranışı değiştirilmeden iç yapısı, okunabilirliği ve tasarımı iyileştirilir. Önceden yazılmış ve yeşil yanan testler bir güvenlik ağı sağlayarak hiçbir şeyin bozulmadığını garanti eder.

question: Why are 'Test Doubles' utilized when testing units of code in modern enterprise applications?
options: To physically duplicate source code repositories across redundant secondary backup servers.
To replace volatile, slow, or external dependencies with controllable and predictable stand-ins.
To force isolated automated unit test suites to run twice to guarantee that race conditions do not exist in threads.
To double the number of lines of test code so development coverage metrics appear higher.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Test Dublörleri (Test Doubles); yavaş, kararsız, dış ağa veya veritabanına bağlı karmaşık bağımlılıkların yerine konan, testin izole ve tahmin edilebilir şekilde koşmasını sağlayan vekil nesnelerdir.

question: According to Gerard Meszaros' taxonomy, what is the specific role of a 'Dummy' object?
options: An object with complex canned return values that verifies exact method argument invocations.
A lightweight working implementation that stores records entirely inside in-memory dictionaries.
An object passed around to satisfy method parameters but never actually invoked or used.
A spy proxy that logs every internal CPU instruction executed by the software under test.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Dummy (Kukla) nesne; yalnızca metot parametre listesini doldurmak (örneğin null geçilemeyen zorunlu parametreler) için aktarılan, test boyunca asla çağrılmayan ve kullanılmayan nesnedir.

question: What is the defining characteristic of a 'Stub' in automated unit testing?
options: It contains full enterprise production business logic connecting to live external payment gateways across enterprise application environments.
It records outgoing invocation arguments and asserts whether total call counts match benchmarks.
It actively verifies whether interaction protocols were executed in strict chronological sequence.
It provides canned answers to calls made during tests, without responding to anything outside scope.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Stub (Taslak / Koçan); test sırasında yapılan çağrılara önceden hazırlanmış sabit hazır cevaplar (canned answers) döner; testin amacının dışındaki durumlara genellikle yanıt vermez.

question: How is a 'Fake' object distinguished from other test double classifications?
options: It has a working implementation, but takes a shortcut making it unsuitable for production.
It possesses zero operational code and throws runtime exceptions whenever any method is called.
It is generated dynamically by operating system hardware registers to simulate power loss.
It verifies behavioral expectations by comparing cryptographic hashes of parameter payloads.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Fake (Sahte) nesne; çalışan gerçek bir uygulamaya (working implementation) sahiptir ancak üretim ortamı için uygun olmayan pratik kısayollar kullanır (örneğin gerçek SQL veritabanı yerine RAM'de Dictionary/List tutan In-Memory DB).

question: What additional responsibility characterizes a 'Spy' compared to a simple Stub?
options: It encrypts all network test packets to prevent unauthorized man-in-the-middle packet sniffing.
It is a stub that also records telemetry about how it was called, such as invocation counts.
It randomly injects corrupt binary data to observe whether the application crashes unexpectedly.
It automatically executes end-to-end browser workflows whenever a unit assertion passes.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Spy (Casus); tıpkı bir stub gibi davranır ancak ek olarak kendisine yapılan çağrıların detaylarını (kaç kez çağrıldı, hangi parametrelerle çağrıldı) kayıt altına alır (record).

question: What distinct verification capability defines a 'Mock' object in unit testing frameworks?
options: It formats source code according to style rules before running automated test assertions.
It replaces hardware memory controllers to speed up static compilation times during builds.
It is pre-programmed with expectations forming a specification of calls it should receive.
It simulates user mouse clicks on graphical user interface buttons inside web browsers.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Mock; hangi metotların, kaç kez ve hangi parametrelerle çağrılacağına dair önceden programlanmış beklentilerle (expectations) donatılmıştır ve davranışsal etkileşimi (interaction testing) doğrular.

question: What is the core distinction between testing with Stubs versus testing with Mocks?
options: Stubs use behavior verification; Mocks rely exclusively on state and return value verification.
Stubs are written exclusively in C#; Mocks can only be compiled in Java development environments.
Stubs require live cloud networks; Mocks operate strictly on physical hard disk partitions.
Stubs facilitate state verification; Mocks verify behavior and interactions between components.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Martin Fowler ve slaytlardaki temel ayrım: Stub'lar durum doğrulama (state verification - dönen değer doğru mu?), Mock'lar ise davranış/etkileşim doğrulama (behavior/interaction verification - doğru metot doğru sırayla çağrıldı mı?) için kullanılır.

question: What symptoms indicate the presence of the 'Fragile Test' code smell?
options: Tests fail frequently due to unrelated refactorings or minor changes in internal implementation.
Tests take several hours to finish executing because of infinite mathematical recursion loops across enterprise application environments.
Tests produce identical passing green results across every possible input combination provided.
Tests automatically recompile operating system kernels whenever an assertion fails in staging.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Fragile (Kırılgan) Test kokusu; sistemin dış davranışı değişmediği halde, iç yapıdaki ufak bir refactoring veya alakasız bir değişiklik yüzünden testlerin sürekli patlaması (bozulması) durumudur.

question: Why is the 'Slow Tests' smell detrimental to high-velocity software engineering teams?
options: Because slow tests cause permanent hardware memory degradation on continuous integration servers.
Because slow test execution forces developers to run tests infrequently, delaying defect feedback.
Because unit testing execution engines automatically delete test files that take over 100 milliseconds.
Because slow tests prevent developers from viewing source code files inside local text editors.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Slow Tests (Yavaş Testler); geliştiricilerin her kod değişiminde testleri çalıştırmaktan vazgeçmesine neden olur. Hızlı geri bildirim (fast feedback) döngüsü koptuğu için hatalar çok geç fark edilir.

question: What characterizes the 'Mystery Guest' test smell according to unit testing best practices?
options: The test runner executes an unexpected test method that was not annotated with a test attribute.
An anonymous developer commits code without including their name in the Git version control log.
The test depends on external files or database state without making the context clear in the test.
A test double returns a random string instead of the value expected by the assertion statement across enterprise application environments.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Mystery Guest (Gizemli Konuk); testin hangi veriye veya duruma göre çalıştığının test koduna bakılarak anlaşılamaması, harici bir dosya veya veritabanındaki görünmeyen verilere gizlice bağımlı olmasıdır.

question: What is a 'Flaky Test', and why is it particularly hazardous to deployment pipelines?
options: A test that takes slightly longer to run on Monday mornings due to distributed high-speed local network connections bandwidth constraints.
A test that executes perfectly on Linux servers but fails to compile on Windows workstations.
A test whose assertions evaluate numerical floating-point numbers without specifying roundoff.
A test that fails intermittently without code changes, eroding trust in the test automation suite.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Flaky (Güvenilmez/Tutarsız) Test; aynı kod üzerinde hiçbir değişiklik yapılmadığı halde bazen geçen bazen kalan testtir (genellikle zamanlama, asenkronluk veya paylaşılan durum kaynaklı). Test takımına duyulan güveni yok eder.

question: What primary quality function does continuous automated testing serve within a CI/CD pipeline?
options: It acts as an automated quality gate, preventing broken builds from progressing to deployment.
It calculates developer productivity by counting total lines of code produced per working hour.
It automatically writes user manual documentation whenever pull requests are merged to main.
It compresses application binary assets to save space on production virtual machine disks.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. CI/CD boru hatlarında sürekli test, bir 'kalite kapısı' (quality gate) görevi görür. Herhangi bir birim veya entegrasyon testi başarısız olduğunda derlemeyi durdurarak hatalı kodun üretime (production) sızmasını engeller.

question: Why is preserving a fast feedback loop considered essential in modern Continuous Integration?
options: So that cloud infrastructure compute bills can be reduced to zero across all staging instances.
So that developers learn about regressions within minutes, while code context is still fresh in mind.
So that software testers do not have to write assertion descriptions in their test method bodies.
So that software applications can bypass regulatory accessibility compliance audits automatically.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Hızlı geri bildirim döngüsü (Fast Feedback Loop) sayesinde geliştirici henüz yazdığı kodun bağlamından (context) kopmadan, dakikalar içinde bir şeyin bozulup bozulmadığını öğrenir ve anında düzeltebilir.

question: Using an in-memory SQLite instance instead of a production PostgreSQL cluster in unit tests is an example of:
options: A Mock, because it verifies that SQL query strings conform to specific syntax grammar conventions.
A Dummy, because the database instance is never queried or referenced during test execution.
A Fake, because it provides a lightweight working implementation unsuitable for live production scale.
A Spy, because it records the precise microsecond timestamp of every table insertion operation across enterprise application environments.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Gerçek PostgreSQL yerine hafif bir In-Memory SQLite kullanmak klasik bir 'Fake' örneğidir; çalışır bir veritabanı mekanizması sunar ancak üretim ortamının ölçek ve dayanıklılık gereksinimlerini karşılamaz.

question: What dangerous pitfall occurs when software developers excessively mock internal collaborators in tests?
options: Tests consume excessive distributed high-speed local network connections bandwidth by transmitting synthetic packets across the internet.
Tests fail to compile because testing frameworks permit only three mock declarations per project.
Tests execute too quickly, causing the build scheduler to report misleading pipeline timing logs.
Tests become tightly coupled to internal implementation details rather than verifying public contracts.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Aşırı mock kullanma (Over-mocking); testleri sistemin gerçek dış davranışını (public contract) test etmek yerine sınıfların iç uygulama detaylarına sıkı sıkıya bağlar ve kod refactor edildiğinde testlerin kırılmasına yol açar.

question: How does strictly adhering to the TDD Green phase help prevent unnecessary over-engineering?
options: By constraining developers to write only the code required to satisfy the immediate failing test.
By automatically generating persistent backend database systems schemas directly from class interface definitions in memory.
By preventing developers from using third-party open-source libraries or package manager modules.
By forbidding the creation of more than five distinct classes within any single software package.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. TDD'nin Green fazı geliştiriciye 'yalnızca mevcut testi geçirecek kadar kod yaz' kuralını koyar. Bu sayede 'belki ileride lazım olur' mantığıyla yazılan gereksiz karmaşık kodların (YAGNI prensibi) önüne geçilir.

question: Which assertion scenario demonstrates behavioral verification utilizing a mock object?
options: Asserting that a user's calculated account balance integer strictly equals 1500 after a deposit.
Asserting that the emailService.sendEmail() method was invoked exactly once with specific parameters.
Asserting that an array returned from a sorting method contains five elements in ascending order.
Asserting that a mathematical squareRoot() computation yields 4.0 when passed the parameter 16.0.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. 'emailService.sendEmail()' metodunun tam olarak bir kez ve doğru parametrelerle çağrıldığını doğrulamak tipik bir davranış/etkileşim doğrulamasıdır (Behavior Verification with Mock).

question: Which assertion scenario exemplifies state verification using a stubbed dependency?
options: Recording all method names invoked on an interface and comparing their call order to an array.
Verifying that the logging service recorded three warning entries with matching timestamp values.
Configuring an exchangeRateStub to return 1.25 and asserting that the calculated euro price is 125.
Injecting distributed high-speed local network connections communication timeouts to evaluate whether the application socket disconnects.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. exchangeRateStub'ın 1.25 dönmesini sağlayıp hesaplanan nihai durumun/çıktının (euro price) 125 olduğunu doğrulamak doğrudan bir durum doğrulamasıdır (State Verification).

question: In unit testing frameworks like NUnit and JUnit, what constitutes a 'Test Fixture'?
options: A software patch applied to production persistent backend database systemss to resolve critical customer reported bugs.
A physical hardware device designed to measure server processor temperature during benchmarks.
A graphical dashboard displaying test execution trends to senior organizational managers.
A fixed baseline environment and set of objects required to execute tests reliably and repeatedly.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Test Fixture; bir testin veya test grubunun tutarlı ve tekrarlanabilir biçimde çalışması için gereken sabit ortam, durum ve test nesneleri kümesidir (@BeforeEach / SetUp ile hazırlanır).

question: What is the primary responsibility of SetUp and TearDown methods in unit testing frameworks?
options: SetUp initializes a clean test state before each test; TearDown cleans up resources afterward.
SetUp compiles raw source files into binaries; TearDown deploys artifacts to cloud staging pods.
SetUp prompts users for input credentials; TearDown prints summary diagnostic receipt receipts.
SetUp monitors CPU electrical consumption; TearDown reboots operating system virtualization nodes.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. SetUp her test metodundan önce çalışarak temiz bir başlangıç durumu oluşturur; TearDown ise her testten sonra açıktaki kaynakları kapatıp temizleyerek (cleanup) testlerin bağımsızlığını korur.

question: Why is TDD often described as a software design technique rather than merely a testing technique?
options: Because TDD replaces the need for user interface designers by generating responsive web layouts.
Because writing tests first forces developers to design modular, decoupled, and testable interfaces.
Because TDD produces UML architectural diagrams automatically from compiled unit test classes.
Because TDD eliminates the necessity for object-oriented inheritance and polymorphism patterns.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. TDD yalnızca bir test yöntemi değil, güçlü bir tasarım tekniğidir; çünkü önce test yazmak kodun nasıl çağrılacağını, arayüzünü (API), bağımlılıklarını ve modülerliğini önceden düşünmeye zorlar.

question: What causes the 'Obscure Test' smell in an enterprise automated unit test suite?
options: The test execution engine runs tests without outputting console messages to developer terminals.
The test file is stored in a hidden directory that developers cannot view without admin permissions.
The test is overly complicated, verbose, or poorly structured, making its intent difficult to comprehend.
The test uses dark-mode syntax highlighting fonts that reduce readability on low-contrast screens across enterprise application environments.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Obscure Test (Anlaşılmaz Test); testin neyi amaçladığının, hangi senaryoyu test ettiğinin aşırı karmaşık kodlar, gereksiz detaylar veya kötü yapılandırma yüzünden anlaşılamamasıdır.

question: What typically causes a Mock verification assertion to fail during unit test execution?
options: The local network connection disconnected while the mock object was executing internal methods.
The underlying operating system ran out of disk swap storage during background batch compilation.
The test runner detected that the target class was written in an outdated software programming language.
An expected method call was not made, was called with wrong arguments, or exceeded expected count.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Mock doğrulamasının fail olması; mock nesneye yapılması beklenen bir çağrının hiç yapılmaması, beklenenden farklı parametrelerle yapılması veya çağrı sayısının (invocation count) uyuşmaması durumunda gerçekleşir.

question: Why are pure functions (functions with no side effects and deterministic outputs) trivial to unit test?
options: Because their outputs depend solely on inputs, requiring no complex mock fixtures or setup state.
Because pure functions automatically execute ten times faster than standard object-oriented methods.
Because testing frameworks are capable of verifying pure functions without writing assertion calls.
Because pure functions compile directly to assembly without requiring intermediate bytecode steps.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Saf fonksiyonlar (Pure Functions); hiçbir dış duruma bağlı olmadıkları ve yan etki (side effect) üretmedikleri için test edilmesi en kolay yapılardır; sadece girdi verilir ve dönen çıktı assert edilir, mock gerekmez.

question: What negative consequence occurs when multiple unit tests share mutable static state variables?
options: The development compiler terminates the build process due to static memory address conflicts.
Test execution results become dependent on execution order, causing unpredictable flakiness.
The unit testing framework automatically converts all tests into slow end-to-end browser tests.
The software application fails to run on operating systems with multi-core microprocessors.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Değiştirilebilir statik durumların (mutable static state) testler arasında paylaşılması; testlerin birbirinin verisini ezmesine, çalışma sırasına bağımlı hale gelmesine ve rastgele patlamalara (flakiness) yol açar.

question: Why does TDD prescribe taking small, incremental steps rather than writing large blocks of code?
options: Small steps allow junior developers to write production code without needing senior code reviews.
Small steps ensure that cloud billing costs for automated CI runners are kept to absolute minimums.
Small steps keep the debugging space tiny, making the cause of any test failure immediately obvious.
Small steps guarantee that the total number of Git commits exceeds team velocity targets across enterprise application environments.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. TDD'de küçük adımlarla ilerlemek hata ayıklama (debugging) alanını küçücük tutar. Test patladığında hatanın son yazılan 2-3 satırdan kaynaklandığı kesin olarak bilinir.

question: When is interaction testing using Mocks particularly appropriate in application architecture?
options: When sorting small in-volatile central processing memory allocations arrays of integer values in descending or ascending sequences.
When calculating complex mathematical algorithms that perform pure floating-point computations.
When formatting text strings and validating standard alphanumeric regular expression patterns.
When verifying communication boundaries where a class delegates responsibilities to a collaborator.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Mock ile etkileşim testi (interaction testing); bir sınıfın işini yaparken diğer bir işbirlikçiye (collaborator - örneğin e-posta servisi, ödeme altyapısı, mesaj kuyruğu) doğru mesajı ilettiğini doğrulamak için idealdir.

question: What is a 'Test Smell' according to Gerard Meszaros and software engineering literature?
options: A symptom in test code that indicates a weakness in test design, maintainability, or reliability.
A physical odor emitted by high-performance computer cooling fans during overnight test runs across enterprise application environments.
A formal warning issued by a compiler when a test class exceeds recommended file size limits.
A failure reported by a testing framework when an assertion comparison encounters a null value.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Test Smells (Test Kokuları); test kodundaki kötü tasarım, bakım zorluğu veya güvenilirlik eksikliğine işaret eden tasarım kusurları ve semptomlarıdır (Flaky, Fragile, Mystery Guest vb.).

question: How does an established suite of unit tests created through TDD provide ongoing regression safety?
options: It eliminates the requirement for writing integration or user acceptance tests in the project.
It acts as a comprehensive safety net that instantly signals if code changes break existing behavior.
It guarantees that server hardware will never suffer power disruptions or distributed high-speed local network connections outages.
It automatically generates updated database schema migrations whenever entities are modified.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. TDD ile adım adım inşa edilen kapsamlı test paketi; gelecekte yapılacak herhangi bir refactoring veya geliştirmede eski davranışların bozulup bozulmadığını anında bildiren güvenilir bir regresyon emniyet ağıdır.

question: What does Statement Coverage (also referred to as Line Coverage) measure in software testing?
options: The percentage of all executable program statements that have been executed by the test suite.
The percentage of boolean condition combinations evaluated to both true and false in tests across enterprise application environments.
The percentage of source code comments reviewed during formal static peer review sessions.
The percentage of mutant programs successfully killed by unit test assertion statements.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. Statement Coverage (Komut / Satır Kapsama); test paketi çalıştırıldığında kaynak koddaki çalıştırılabilir ifadelerin (statements) yüzde kaçının en az bir kez yürütüldüğünü ölçer.

question: How is Branch Coverage (also known as Decision Coverage) formally defined in white-box testing?
options: The fraction of executable lines containing arithmetic calculations exercised by test cases.
The fraction of decision outcomes (both true and false branches) exercised by test executions.
The fraction of hardware processor branches predicted correctly during high-speed execution across enterprise application environments.
The fraction of Git repository branches that have been successfully merged into the main line.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: B. Branch Coverage (Dal / Karar Kapsama); koddaki her bir karar noktasının (if, switch vb.) her bir olası dalının (hem True hem False kollarının) testler tarafından en az bir kez işletilip işletilmediğini denetler.

question: What is the structural relationship between Statement Coverage and Branch Coverage?
options: Achieving 100% Statement Coverage automatically guarantees achieving 100% Branch Coverage.
Statement Coverage and Branch Coverage evaluate completely disjoint subsets of application code.
Achieving 100% Branch Coverage guarantees 100% Statement Coverage, but the reverse is not true.
Neither metric subsumes the other because branch decisions never execute statement expressions.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: C. Kapsama hiyerarşisinde Branch Coverage, Statement Coverage'ı kapsar (subsumes). %100 Branch Coverage sağlandığında tüm satırlar da mecburen çalışacağı için %100 Statement Coverage sağlanmış olur; fakat tersi doğru değildir (örneğin gövdesiz bir if bloğunun else kolu çalışmasa da satır kapsaması %100 çıkabilir).

question: For a decision containing 'n' independent atomic boolean conditions, how many test cases does MCC require?
options: It requires exactly n test cases to evaluate each condition in isolation from remaining inputs.
It requires 2 * n test cases to evaluate true and false states for every individual variable.
It requires n + 1 test cases to verify that each condition can independently affect the outcome.
It requires 2^n test cases to evaluate all possible truth table combinations of the conditions.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: D. Multiple Condition Coverage (MCC); bir karardaki tüm bağımsız atomik koşulların oluşturabileceği tüm doğruluk tablosu kombinasyonlarını test etmeyi gerektirir. n adet koşul varsa 2^n adet test senaryosu gerekir.

question: What is the primary requirement of Modified Condition/Decision Coverage (MC/DC)?
options: Each condition must be shown to independently affect the decision outcome, holding others fixed.
Every statement must be executed at least ten times under varied floating-point volatile central processing memory allocations values.
All possible permutations of loops must be executed up to their maximum theoretical bounds.
Every database transaction must be rolled back to verify disk persistence recovery limits.
explanation: Doğru Cevap: A. MC/DC (Modified Condition/Decision Coverage); her bir koşulun, diğer koşullar sabit tutulduğunda nihai karar sonucunu bağımsız olarak değiştirebildiğini (independently affect outcome) göstermeyi şart koşar.

question: How many test cases are required to satisfy MC/DC for a decision containing 'n' independent conditions?
options: It requires 2^n tests, matching the full exponential combinatorial requirements of the MCC metric.
It requires n + 1 test cases, providing linear scalability for safety-critical systems.
It requires exactly n * (n - 1) test cases to evaluate all possible pairwise interactions.
It requires only 2 tests regardless of how many conditions are combined in the logical predicate.
